## Why

Each agent's view file, such as `src/agent/coordinator.view.md`, is meant to hold what its model sees on every turn (DEVELOPMENT.md section 5). The spike in #182 logged the Messages API requests that Agent SDK 0.3.301 sends, and found text the view file doesn't show. With a custom `systemPrompt` string, as the app uses, the coordinator's first user message is followed by a block from Claude Code that starts with `# Environment`. It holds the working folder, whether it's a git repository, the platform, shell, and OS version, a rule about downloaded files and running Python with `-I`, the model's name and knowledge cutoff, the list of agent types for the `Agent` tool, and today's date. So the model reads instructions we didn't write, and a trace or a view file doesn't show them.

## Design

- DEVELOPMENT.md section 5, on view files.
- [research/agent-evaluations.md](https://github.com/nimbusscale/road-trip-agent/blob/main/research/agent-evaluations.md), section 2.8 (once the #182 PR merges), which shows the agent-type list from this block.
- The SDK's `systemPrompt` option in `node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts`, which documents `excludeDynamicSections` for the preset prompt only.

## Open questions

- ~~Is the block on the app's coordinator too, and on its workers? The spike ran outside the app, in a git repository. On the server the working folder is the container's.~~ Answered on 2026-10-27, in research section 2.9: yes. It's on the app's coordinator from the first turn of each session, and on every worker, and the same when the coordinator runs from an agent definition. On the server it says `/app`, not a git repository, and a date in UTC.
- ~~Can it be turned off, or cut down, with an SDK option or an environment variable? If not, should the view file show it?~~ Answered on 2026-10-27, in research section 2.9: no setting found turns it off and keeps the plan's sign-in. Whether the view file shows it moved to #194.
- ~~Does its date or its rules ever conflict with the coordinator's own instructions?~~ Answered on 2026-10-27, in research section 2.9: its date does. It's in the server's time zone, UTC, and the app's is at the trip's start place, so they differ each evening in the US. The rest doesn't conflict. How to handle it moved to #194.

## Do

- Log one coordinator turn's request in the app, as the #182 spike did, and record what the block holds.
- Answer the open questions, and propose a change if one is needed.

## Done when

- The open questions are answered, with the logged block.

## Ends in

A decision, or a PR.

## Settled in

Chat.
